remarks: Perched high just one block from downtown Glenville, this 3,000 sq ft gem sits on a gorgeous .27 acre, meticulously manicured lot. From the foyer, you are greeted by the oversized cathedral-ceiling living room and dining space, complete with a wet bar. Breakfast bar, skylights, beautiful hardwood floors, and a stone fireplace complete this space. Sliders lead to the sprawling 40' trex deck, allowing for multi-tiered living and exceptional entertaining spaces. The chef's kitchen has a prep island, beautiful wood cabinets, and a Viking appliance suite. The main level primary suite offers 2 large walk-in closets, while the walk-out lower level has 9'+ ceilings and another full bathroom. Au-pair/In-law suite, as well as 4/5th bedroom options. Taxes are $8,000 annually and FAR remaining, with new HVAC condenser, brand new stone garden wall.
